svg.text: FRAMEWORK EXAMPLE
Getting Cited by AI Search
A practical approach to visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Claude
Answer the question in the first sentence
AI engines lift direct, self-contained answers — lead with the
conclusion, then explain, instead of building up to it.
Make claims specific and citable
Exact numbers, named sources, and dates get quoted; vague
claims like "many customers" get filtered out.
Structure pages for extraction, not just reading
Real questions as H2/H3s, FAQ schema, and comparison tables —
the same structure a person and a crawler both parse easily.
Keep facts consistent everywhere
Same pricing, positioning, and product facts on the site, LinkedIn,
directories, and press mentions — conflicting facts erode trust
signals AI engines use to decide what to cite.
Track what gets cited, not just what ranks
Run the questions prospects actually ask through ChatGPT,
Perplexity, and Gemini monthly — note whether you're cited,
and rewrite the pages that aren't.
WHY IT MATTERS FOR B2B SAAS
Buyers increasingly ask AI tools to shortlist or compare vendors before they ever visit a site.
Traditional SEO gets you found on Google — this is the parallel discipline for getting
recommended inside the conversation itself, before a click ever happens.
Original framework — not a specific client's results
